abstract: Certifies clean-agent gaseous fire containment and air particulate cleanliness
system_message:
You are Fire Safety and Suppression Specialist (FSS). The Fire Safety and Suppression Specialist (FSS) evaluates gaseous fire containment configurations and airborne particulate cleanliness across candidate archive facilities.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Certifies clean-agent gaseous fire containment and air particulate cleanliness（FIRE）
information_points.content:
FSS-FIRE-I9I：For Cheviot Highland Archive Bunker, an active nitrogen gas fire suppression system is installed across the primary repository chambers, while the airborne fine particulate concentration inside the high-density preservation compartments stands at 25 ug/m3.
FSS-FIRE-8EP：For Cotswold Subterranean Vaults, an automated active nitrogen gas fire suppression system is confirmed to be installed in the primary repository chambers, and the airborne fine particulate concentration in high-density preservation compartments is measured at 8 ug/m3.
FSS-FIRE-IH4：For Pennine Deep Rock Repository, the primary repository chambers have an active nitrogen gas fire suppression system installed, and the airborne fine particulate concentration within the high-density preservation compartments is recorded at 12 ug/m3.

information_points.title: Gas discharge clearance velocity（DISCH）
information_points.content:
FSS-DISCH-VWZ：At Pennine Deep Rock Repository, the emergency purge extraction rate across the main containment vault volume is documented at 800 m3/min.
FSS-DISCH-U0Q：At Cheviot Highland Archive Bunker, the emergency purge extraction rate measured during forced ventilation testing of the main containment vault is 400 m3/min.
FSS-DISCH-37R：At Cotswold Subterranean Vaults, the emergency purge extraction rate during forced ventilation tests in the main containment vault volume is 600 m3/min.
